after.zh: 挡板越大，热图越平滑、越粗：一块挡板盖住的地方多，分到每格的就模糊了。挡板太小，又可能一块也盖不住模型认的那个部件。实际做遮挡实验，挡板大小要跟物体的部件差不多大。
after.en: The bigger the patch, the smoother and coarser the heat map: each patch covers more, so what it finds is smeared over more cells. Too small a patch, though, may never cover the whole part the model recognises. In practice the patch is chosen about the size of the object's parts.

t.zh: <part-ref to="own-11-2"></part-ref>用的挡板是 3×3。挡板该多大，没有一定之规：太小，盖不住模型认的那个部件；太大，热图糊成一片。
t.en: The <part-ref to="own-11-2"></part-ref> uses a 3×3 patch. There is no fixed rule for the patch size: too small and it never covers the part the model recognises; too large and the heat map blurs into one blob.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：换成 5×5 的灰色挡板，输出每个位置分数掉多少。
t.en: Your task in this level: use a 5×5 grey patch, and output how far the score drops at each place.

caption.zh: 第一组：老实的分类器，5×5 挡板
caption.en: Set 1: an honest classifier, a 5×5 patch

brief.zh: 换一块 5×5 的灰色挡板。在每一格输出：挡住以它为中心的 5×5，分数掉多少。
brief.en: Use a 5×5 grey patch instead. At every cell, output how much the score drops when it covers the 5×5 centred there.

hint.zh: 3×3 的块和是邻居一格以内的格子加起来；5×5 是两格以内。平移可以一次挪好几格。
hint.en: A 3×3 block sum adds the cells up to one away; a 5×5 one, up to two away. Shift can move several cells at once.
